corrected_proposal.full_proposal_markdown:
# Proposal: Warehouse Visibility Platform for NordFrame Logistics GmbH

**Submitted by:** Clarion Data Systems
**Client:** NordFrame Logistics GmbH

## 1. Executive Summary
Clarion Data Systems is pleased to submit this comprehensive proposal to deliver a centralized web-based inventory dashboard for NordFrame Logistics GmbH. Leveraging our extensive DACH region logistics expertise, our solution provides real-time visibility across all 6 regional warehouses in Germany and Austria. We guarantee direct integration with your existing PostgreSQL database without migration, enforce strict Role-Based Access Control, and commit fully to your 3-month pilot and 6-month rollout timeline at a fixed price within your budget.

## 2. Proposed Technical Solution
We will deliver a modern, scalable web-based dashboard utilizing a responsive React and Node.js architecture. The platform connects securely to your environment, featuring real-time data synchronization, intuitive UI workflows, and automated low-stock alerting based on user-configurable inventory thresholds.

## 3. PostgreSQL Database Integration
In strict compliance with your technical mandates, our architecture integrates directly with your existing legacy PostgreSQL inventory database. No database migration, schema restructuring, or data platform replacement is required, ensuring zero disruption to current database operations.

## 4. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
The platform incorporates robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Warehouse managers are restricted to viewing and managing inventory data exclusively for their assigned regional facility, while HQ executives and supply chain directors are granted aggregated, cross-site visibility across all 6 locations.

## 5. Automated Low-Stock Alerts
Automated notification mechanisms will be embedded into the dashboard. Warehouse managers will configure custom safety stock thresholds per item, triggering instant in-app alerts and automated email notifications when stock levels drop below acceptable operational limits.

## 6. Timeline, Onboarding, and Data Migration Plan
We commit to a structured 6-month deployment roadmap:
- **Months 1–3:** Discovery, design, development, and working pilot deployment at the first warehouse.
- **Months 4–6:** Phased rollout and employee onboarding across the remaining 5 warehouses with zero operational downtime.

## 7. Support, Maintenance, and SLAs
We include a comprehensive 12-month post-implementation support and maintenance agreement. This features a dedicated helpdesk, 99.9% platform uptime SLA, and guaranteed response times of under 2 hours for critical severity-1 inventory outages.

## 8. Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks
- **Assumptions:** Timely client provisioning of database read-access credentials and availability of key stakeholder personnel for weekly sprint reviews.
- **Risks & Mitigation:** Potential query performance bottlenecks on the legacy database during peak operating hours will be mitigated through optimized indexing, query caching, and connection pooling.

## 9. Pricing and Commercial Terms
We offer a firm fixed-price fee of **€95,000**, which is fully inclusive of software development, database integration, project management, user training, and the first year of comprehensive support and maintenance. This aligns perfectly with NordFrame's €80,000–€120,000 budget.

## 10. Why Clarion
Clarion has successfully delivered inventory and logistics dashboards for several mid-size distribution companies across the DACH region, combining technical excellence with rigorous project governance.
